snippet.title: Trailer for the game "Mess in the Toy Shop"
snippet.description:
Just the simple joy of putting toys back on the shelves. Dive into a relaxing gameplay experience where every toy has its place. Turn a messy toy shop into a perfectly organized store. Unlock new skills, improve your efficiency, and have fun.

Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5022130/Mess_in_the_Toy_Shop/
